desc: Write Python program to read N and A array, factor each A_i, collect per-prime exponent lists.
For each prime p: compute S=sum(e_i), precompute p^v mod MOD for v=0..2S.
Run DP over positions i=1..N with two flags (zero seen), using transitions add and subtract as described, summing contributions p^{new_v}.
Multiply F_p for all primes and output answer mod 998244353.
